\# {.sidebar}

```{r}
#| warning: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
df <- read_csv("RateData/combinedratedata.csv")

head(df)
```

```{r}

selectInput(
  inputId = "selected_utility", 
  label = "Select Utility to Compare:",
  choices = sort(unique(df$`Utility Name`)),
  selected = "My Water Company"
)

plotOutput("comparison_plot")
```

```{r}
# Render the interactive plot
plotOutput("comparison_plot")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

output$comparison_plot <- renderPlot({
  target <- input$selected_utility
  
  # Filter data for the selected utility
  selected_df <- df %>% filter(`Utility Name` == target)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = "All Utilities", y = `Minimum Charge`)) +
    # Overall distribution boxplot
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.3) +
    # Show all other utility points in the background for context
    geom_jitter(width = 0.08, color = "gray60", alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    # Highlight the selected utility's point(s) in a distinct color/shape
    geom_point(data = selected_df, aes(x = "All Utilities", y = `Minimum Charge`), 
               color = "firebrick", size = 5, shape = 18) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Minimum Charge Comparison:", target, "vs. Industry Distribution"),
      subtitle = "Red diamond indicates the minimum charge for the selected utility",
      x = "",
      y = "Minimum Charge ($)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(plot.title.position = "plot")
})
```
